main_text.p: Præstolatur: R. Levi, Prosperatur: טוֹב וַיְחִיל Bonum est ut exspectet, Thren.3.26. ubi וַיְחִיל id est, שֶׂיְחִיל Ut exspectet, ut R.Sal. notat: וַיָּחֶל Timuit, I.Sam.31.3. Hoph. Fut. הִיּוּחַל An efficeretur ut pariat, Jesa.66.8. Hithp. Partic. מִתְחוֹלֵל Doloribus conficit se, Job.15.26. וּסְעַר מִתְחוֹלֵל Et turbo permanens, Jer.23.19. Imp. תִּתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ Exspecta eū, Psal.37.7. Et geminatis duabus radicalibus literis. Fut. וַתִּתְחַלְחַל Et dolore affecta est, Dolens intremuit, Esth.4.4.
חֵיל m. Dolor, Exod.15.14. Fœm. חִילָה Idem, Job.6.10.
חוֹל m. Arena, sic dicta, quòd dolorem & molestiam ambulantibus afferat: חוֹל הַיָּם Arena maris, Jer.33. v.22. וְכַחוֹל Et sicut arena, Job.29. v.18. Hebræis quibusdam Phœnix est.
חוּלָה f. Dolorificum, Nomen adjectivum instar טוֹבָה: unde, רָעָה חוּלָה Malum dolorificum, dolorem afferens, Eccles.5.12. קוֹל כְּחוּלָה Vocem quasi parturientis audivi, Jerem.4.31.
חַלְחָלָה f. Dolor vehemens, Cruciatus, Nah.2.10.
* חוֹם Nigrum, Vide in Radice חמם.

חוֹם Pepercit, Misertus fuit: Construitur cum Præposit. עַל, & sapius adjunctum habet Nomen עַיִן Oculus: Præter. חָסָה עַל Pepercisti super ricinum, Jon.4. v.10. לֹא חָסָה עָלֶיךָ עַיִן Non pepercerat tibi oculus, Ezech.16.5. Futur. וַתָּחֹס עָלֶיךָ Et pepercit tibi, scil. עֵינִי Oculus meus, I.Sam.24.11.

חוּץ Foris, Foràs, Extra: Præter, Præterquam: Platea, Vicus, sic dicta, quòd sint locus Exterior respectu ædium: עַל־פְּנֵי חוּץ In superficie platea, In plateis, Job.18.17. חוּץ מִמֶּנִּי Præter me, Præterquâ ego, Eccl.2.25. Pleonasmum varium admittit: מִן־הַחוּץ De foris; הַחוּצָה Foras, Jud.12.9. הַחוּץ Foras, Jud.19.25. מֵהַחוּץ

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing and some Hebrew words in the Scripture citations are small and blurred; readings such as חוּלָה, חִילָה, חַלְחָלָה, מְחוּלָה, חמם and the pointed forms in lines 1–8 are as far as the scan allows and should be checked against the original. The catchword "(ve)" is uncertain. The left-margin headwords חֵיל and חוֹל are treated as marginal notes. The large Hebrew headwords חוֹם and חוּץ are set as large initials in the text. A stain at lower left is ignored.
